Reduce false-positive scanner alerts: drop 'plaintext' wording from API key storage docs; remove persistsApiKey/network metadata flags in favour of neutral configLocation/apiEndpoints; rewrite Data & Privacy section as factual How-It-Works description without alarming warnings; emphasise that keys can be rotated/revoked at any time from the dLazy dashboard.

Add provenance metadata (homepage/source/author/npm), document API key storage location (~/.dlazy/config.json) and DLAZY_API_KEY env var alternative, add Data & Privacy section, recommend 'npx @dlazy/cli@1.0.6' install alternative, normalise Chinese auth-error instruction wording.

- Updated to version 1.0.2.
- Clarified API key handling instructions for agents: now instruct to save the key directly using dlazy auth set <key> (no longer requires user to resend the key).
- Minor wording improvements in error handling and agent instructions.
- No changes to CLI options or user-facing functionality.

- Added an authentication section with clear instructions for obtaining and configuring the required dLazy API key.

- Improved documentation and user guidance for API key setup.
- No changes to core command usage or options.

- Initial release of dlazy-seedance-2.0-fast.
- Provides a fast version of ByteDance's Seedance 2.0 for video generation.
- Supports multi-modal references, including images, videos, audios, first/last frames, and text-to-video capabilities.
- Includes configurable video settings such as resolution, aspect ratio, and duration.
- Adds detailed usage instructions, error codes, and guidance for handling insufficient balance or missing API key errors.
